events.name: The Odyssey
events.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

events.name: Moana
events.description: Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana.'

events.name: Minions & Monsters
events.description: Follows the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they search for frightening creatures for their monster movie, partner with a green creature, and must save the planet after unleashing monsters.

events.name: Toy Story 5
events.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.
